mustFind.summary: If the load fails and the user then saves a unit successfully, loadFailed is cleared even though the workout mode was never confirmed — Retry disappears and the row shows FOCUS while the server holds QUICK.
loadFailed is a stored copy of 'some field is unconfirmed'; each field's write path clears it alone, so it drifts from the facts (Single Source of Truth).

After a failed load, a successful chooseUnit clears loadFailed though viewWrite was never confirmed: Retry disappears and the control draws FOCUS while the server holds QUICK; the unit PUT's own answer carried QUICK and chooseUnit discards it.
The label-to-option mapping is unpinned: swapping it so the option tagged QUICK reads Focus passes every test.
The guard that stops a load begun before a successful mode write from overwriting it is untested: removing it passes.
Nothing pins the Workout mode row behind the hasLoaded gate: drawing it in the skeleton branch passes every test, FirstFrameLoaderUiTest included.
